summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, reporting its results for the first quarter of 2026. The filing is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, containing standard financial disclosures and operational updates. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change—is described. The filing serves only to satisfy SEC reporting obligations and does not announce any corporate action that would classify it as a special situation.
